India Considers User Levies for $42 Billion Strategic Fuel Reserves

India is considering imposing levies on cooking and natural gas users to finance a planned $42 billion strategic fuel reserve. Sources indicate this plan could raise approximately $1.5 billion annually. The proposed financing mechanism involves charging users to fund the construction and maintenance of gas storage infrastructure. This initiative aims to bolster the nation's energy security through a substantial emergency fuel stockpile.
